sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
ASTEROIDS' core gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging. The game takes place in a two-dimensional space where you control a small spaceship that must destroy asteroids while avoiding their deadly collisions. The game starts with a single asteroid, and as you progress, more asteroids will appear, increasing the difficulty level. Your spaceship can move left or right, and you can shoot asteroids using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls.

The game's physics engine is well-implemented, providing a realistic and immersive experience. The asteroids will split into smaller pieces when hit, creating a chain reaction that can lead to a high score. However, be careful, as these smaller pieces can be just as deadly as the original asteroids. As you progress, you'll encounter various types of asteroids, each with its own size, speed, and behavior.

To succeed in ASTEROIDS, you'll need to develop a strategy for managing your shots, dodging asteroids, and adapting to changing situations. The game's pace is fast, and you'll need to react quickly to avoid collisions and maximize your scores. With its simple yet addictive gameplay mechanics, ASTEROIDS is an excellent choice for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

ASTEROIDS features a variety of power-ups that can be collected during gameplay. These power-ups include speed boosts, laser upgrades, and shields that can protect your spaceship from collisions. Collecting power-ups can significantly improve your gameplay experience, allowing you to achieve higher scores and overcome challenging situations. However, be careful not to get too distracted by power-ups, as they can also increase the difficulty level of the game.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:

Avoid colliding with asteroids, as this will result in a game over. Instead, try to dodges them by moving your spaceship left or right.

Collect power-ups whenever possible. Power-ups can significantly improve your gameplay experience and help you achieve higher scores.

Finally, don't get discouraged if you die. ASTEROIDS is a challenging game, and it's normal to die a few times before you get the hang of it. Keep practicing, and you'll eventually improve your skills and achieve high scores.
